question: Out of 1 crore app installs for a fintech app in India, how many will become paying users?
idealClarificationQuestions: Paying user = made at least one paid transaction (subscription, premium feature, fee-bearing)? Yes.
Time horizon: in first 90 days post-install? Yes — 90-day window.
Fintech app type: investments/broking (Groww, Zerodha) or payments (PhonePe, Paytm)? Use mid-broking app reference (closer to Groww/Zerodha).
Installs include uninstalls? Net active installs after Day 7 cleanup.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Standard fintech funnel: Install → Open → Register/KYC → Activate → Transact → Pay.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Sign-up / start KYC: ~50% of openers = 35 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Activate (first transaction or first deposit): ~40% of KYC-completed = 7.6 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~1.5 lakh paying users from 1 crore installs (~1.5% conversion).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Complete KYC (PAN + Aadhaar verification — fintech is heavy here)
Become paying users (broking fees, subscription, premium)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~1.5 lakh paying users from 1 crore installs (~1.5% conversion).

calculationFlow: Sign-up / start KYC: ~50% of openers = 35 lakh.
Complete KYC (PAN + Aadhaar verification — fintech is heavy here): ~55% of starters = 19 lakh.
Activate (first transaction or first deposit): ~40% of KYC-completed = 7.6 lakh.
Become paying users (broking fees, subscription, premium): ~20% of activated = 1.5 lakh.
Round: ~1.5 lakh paying users from 1 crore installs (~1.5% conversion).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~1.5 lakh paying users from 1 crore installs (~1.5% conversion).
